toolAccessMatrix.description: Complete tool access configuration for the debug-specialist agent with token budgets and usage guidelines

mandatory.description: Tools that MUST be used for every debugging session

tools.name: vibe-check
tools.purpose: Error prevention, assumption identification, tunnel vision breaking
tools.usage: ALWAYS first step in any debugging workflow

example.plan: 1. Reproduce error 2. Analyze stack trace 3. Fix type mismatch
uncertainties: Is this a frontend or backend type issue?

primary.description: Core debugging tools for most scenarios

tools.name: filesystem
tools.usage: Reading error sources, implementing fixes, searching patterns
bestPractices: Use Glob for finding files by name
Use Edit for targeted fixes (preserves formatting)

tools.name: ide
tools.usage: Get compilation errors, type conflicts, and IDE insights
tools.note: Use via bash: npx tsc --noEmit for type checking

tools.name: playwright
tools.purpose: Browser automation, visual debugging, E2E test execution
tools.usage: Reproduce visual bugs, debug test failures, performance profiling
bestPractices: Use browser_snapshot for accessibility tree (better than screenshots)
Capture console messages for runtime errors

tools.name: bash
tools.purpose: Run tests, compile TypeScript, execute scripts
tools.usage: npm test, tsc, git commands, general CLI operations
tools.notes: Prefer bash for pre-approved commands (0 token cost)

secondary.description: Specialized tools for specific debugging scenarios

tools.name: postgresql
tools.purpose: Production database debugging, query optimization, schema analysis
tools.usage: Slow queries, RLS policy bugs, data inconsistencies
whenToUse: Debugging slow API endpoints (check query performance)
Data not appearing in UI (check database state)

tools.name: sqlite-tanium
tools.purpose: Local database debugging (practice questions, offline data)
tools.usage: Debug TCO quiz data, practice exam issues
tools.note: Use for local/offline debugging, NOT production

tools.name: github
tools.purpose: Issue tracking, PR debugging, code search across repos
tools.usage: Find when bug was introduced, search similar issues, track bug reports
whenToUse: Need to find when bug was introduced (git blame alternative)
Search for similar bugs across codebase
Debug issues reported in GitHub Issues
tools.warning: High token cost - use only when git log insufficient

tools.name: archon
tools.purpose: Task management, project tracking, knowledge base search
tools.usage: Get debugging tasks, update status, search documentation

tools.name: vibe-learn
tools.purpose: Pattern recognition and learning from debugging sessions
tools.usage: Record recurring errors, solutions, and anti-patterns

parameters.category: Complex Solution Bias | Feature Creep | Premature Implementation | Misalignment | Overtooling | Preference | Success | Other

whenToUse: When learning a new debugging technique

secondary.totalCost: Up to ~40K if all used (rarely needed)
secondary.selectionGuidance: Use only what's needed for specific debugging scenario

standard.useFor: Type errors, compilation issues, logic bugs

integration.useFor: E2E test failures, visual bugs, browser issues

performance.useFor: Slow queries, render performance, memory leaks

budgetGuidelines.target: Stay under 32K for most debugging sessions

decisionTree.description: Tool selection based on debugging scenario

typeError.workflow: vibe-check → tsc diagnostics → read files → fix types → verify

runtimeError.workflow: vibe-check → read stack trace → identify source → fix → test

visualBug.workflow: vibe-check → screenshot/snapshot → analyze CSS → fix → verify visually

testFailure.workflow: vibe-check → reproduce failure → analyze test → fix → run 10+ times

slowPerformance.workflow: vibe-check → profile → identify bottleneck → optimize → benchmark

databaseIssue.workflow: vibe-check → check query → analyze schema → fix → verify data

historicalBug.workflow: vibe-check → git log/diff → identify change → fix → test

antiPatterns.description: Common tool selection mistakes to avoid

mistakes.instead: Use decision tree to select minimal viable toolset

mistakes.cost: 2K saved, but causes cascading errors costing 10-50K to fix

mistakes.pattern: Using github MCP for git history
mistakes.instead: Use bash git commands (0K tokens, pre-approved)
Use filesystem + bash for non-visual bugs
Only use when database is confirmed issue

archonIntegration.statusUpdates: Update task status at each major step

vibeCheckIntegration.learnPatterns: Use vibe_learn after fixing recurring issues

neverTogether: github + bash (git) - use bash for git operations
postgresql + sqlite-tanium - different databases, choose one
alwaysTogether: vibe-check + any other tool - mandatory pairing
